# Differential scenarios for the Prometheus engine. The Go generator in go/main.go and the Rust
# tests in tests/exposition.rs both replay this file; the Go output is in golden/.
# Values are percent-decoded (%20 space, %22 quote, %5C backslash, %0A newline, %25 percent).
# Every argument not given is the Go zero value.

# The startup scrape with Go's viper defaults for metrics.disabled_metrics (config/config.go).
scenario startup_viper_defaults
namespace pbs
subsystem srv
disabled account_adapter_details=false account_debug=true account_stored_responses=true adapter_connections_metrics=true adapter_connections_dial_metrics=true adapter_buyeruid_scrubbed=true adapter_gdpr_request_blocked=false
syncer adnxs rubicon pubmatic 33across ix
module prebid_ortb2blocking bidder_request raw_bidder_response
module prebid_rulesengine processed_auction_request
module fiftyonedegrees_devicedetection entrypoint raw_auction_request
module scope3_rtd entrypoint processed_auction_request auction_response

# No prefix at all and every optional metric disabled: the disabled families are not registered
# and the account-level toggles suppress the account series.
scenario no_prefix_all_disabled
disabled account_adapter_details=true account_debug=true account_stored_responses=true adapter_connections_metrics=true adapter_connections_dial_metrics=true adapter_buyeruid_scrubbed=true adapter_gdpr_request_blocked=true account_modules_metrics=true
RecordRequest rtype=openrtb2-web pub=acct status=ok cookie=no size=500
RecordDebugRequest enabled=true pub=acct
RecordStoredResponse pub=acct
RecordAdapterConnections adapter=AppNexus reused=true d=1000
RecordAdapterBuyerUIDScrubbed adapter=AppNexus
RecordAdapterGDPRRequestBlocked adapter=AppNexus
RecordBidValidationCreativeSizeError adapter=AppNexus account=acct
RecordBidValidationCreativeSizeWarn adapter=AppNexus account=acct
RecordBidValidationSecureMarkupError adapter=AppNexus account=acct
RecordBidValidationSecureMarkupWarn adapter=AppNexus account=acct

# Connection metrics on but dial metrics off: the dial families are nested and stay absent.
scenario subsystem_only_conn_without_dial
subsystem sub
disabled adapter_connections_metrics=false adapter_connections_dial_metrics=true
RecordAdapterConnections adapter=AppNexus reused=true d=1000
RecordAdapterConnections adapter=AppNexus reused=false d=60000000
RecordAdapterConnections adapter=Unknown reused=true d=0

# A namespace alone, duplicate syncer keys, and a module without stages.
scenario namespace_only_edge_preload
namespace ns
syncer dup dup other
module emptymod
module onestage exitpoint
RecordModuleCalled module=emptymod stage=entrypoint d=10
RecordModuleCalled module=onestage stage=exitpoint d=5000000

# Adapter names at the edges of the lower casing: empty, ADKERNELADN with U+212A KELVIN SIGN for
# its K (it lowers onto the sample adapter adkerneladn), a titlecase digraph (U+01C5) and
# fullwidth capitals; and prices of either zero.
scenario edge_adapter_names
namespace edge
RecordAdapterRequest rtype=openrtb2-web adapter= cookie=exists bids=bid errors=timeout
RecordAdapterRequest rtype=openrtb2-app adapter=AD%E2%84%AAERNELADN cookie=no bids=nobid
RecordAdapterRequest adapter=%EF%BC%A1%EF%BC%B0%EF%BC%B0 cookie=unknown bids=bid

RecordAdapterPrice adapter= cpm=-0
